data_issues: (1) Unit/channel order in test_unlabeled is scrambled relative to train/val: the 19 columns of the test X are permuted (e.g. test unit 14 = train unit 0, test 4 = train 16, test 16 = train 14, test 18 = train 2, test 0 = train 17). Recovered mapping test_col->train_unit = [17, 10, 4, 18, 16, 9, 12, 7, 8, 6, 5, 11, 3, 15, 0, 1, 14, 13, 2], found by maximizing test likelihood under a Poisson class-mixture fit on labeled data (log-lik -417 unpermuted vs +504 permuted); test columns were re-ordered before decoding. (2) The labeled data contain duplicated / near-duplicated trials: 13 exact duplicate rows in train, 3 val trials identical to train trials, and most train trials have a same-class near-copy at L1 distance <=4 (vs >=7 between genuinely independent trials, as in test). Only ~120 independent trials underlie the 282 labeled trials, and val leaks from train, so naive CV/val accuracy is inflated (RF 0.93 naive CV vs ~0.43 group CV). Honest group-CV accuracy is ~0.46.
